brand.tagline: Log it. Rate it. Argue it out.

demo.banner: No backend is connected, so everything runs in your browser with sample people and reviews. What you log stays on this device.
demo.bannerServer: Sample people and reviews. What you log may reset.

about.title: About CritiComrade
about.description: A shared diary for films, shows, books and albums. Log what you finished, rate it in half stars, follow friends and challenge them to watch what you loved.

footer.demo: Running in demo mode: your data stays in this browser.
footer.demoServer: Running on the hosted demo API.

sidebar.joinText: Log what you finish, follow friends, and see where your taste overlaps.

landing.lede: CritiComrade is a shared diary for films, shows, books and albums. Rate what you finished in half stars, follow the people whose taste you trust, and find out exactly where you disagree.
landing.demoNote: The demo signs you in as a guest with sample friends and reviews. Nothing leaves your browser.
landing.quote: The final shot. That is the review.
landing.booksHint: Novels, essays, the one you abandoned
landing.albumsHint: Records you played start to finish
landing.diaryText: Log every title with a half-star rating, the date you finished it, and as much or as little as you want to say. Your year adds itself up.
landing.comradesText: Your feed is the people you chose, not an algorithm. Each profile shows a taste match, so you know whose five stars to trust.
landing.challengesText: Dare someone to watch, read or play something you love within a deadline. They earn points if they finish it.
landing.ctaTitle: Your diary is one click away
landing.demoNoteServer: The demo signs you in as a guest with sample friends and reviews. It resets now and then.
